decision: Reprimand for the driver. This is the driver's 2nd Reprimand of the Season (Driving).
event_name: Date 08 April 2022 Time 21:05 2022 AUSTRALIAN GRAND PRIX 7 - 10 April 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 25 & 26) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Impeding of Car 55 by Car 22 at turn 2.
offence: Breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Reprimand for the driver. This is the driver's 2nd Reprimand of the Season (Driving).
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 22 (Yuki Tsunoda), the driver of Car 55 (Carlos Sainz) and team representatives and examined video evidence. TSU exited pit lane and entered turns 1 and 2 knowing SAI was quickly approaching on a push lap. After entering turns 1 and 2, SAI came up behind TSU, who was moving slowly on the racing line at turn 2 and was, therefore, impeded.
rules_referenced: Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 22 Impeding Car 55
